info.title: CertificateOfOrigins api
info.description: C14 code-first contract for the api (external / service-to-service) domain. Exported from /openapi/v1.json of the running application, filtered to the api/ prefix, with components.schemas reduced to the transitive $ref closure of those paths. HttpQuery endpoints are absent by construction - ASP.NET does not emit them into the generated document.
